others.reason: BepiPred-3.0 cannot be installed unattended: DTU Health Tech does not allow redistributing the package, so bepipred-3.0b.src.zip has to be downloaded manually with an academic account and wired through BEPIPRED_ZIP/BEPIPRED_HOME. The protocol's own validator reports it as missing instead of failing silently.
Same dependency as tests.TestBepiPredPrediction: BepiPred-3.0 is a manual, non-redistributable download wired through BEPIPRED_ZIP/BEPIPRED_HOME.

The IEDB MHC-I standalone tool is served behind a license acceptance form at tools.iedb.org, with no stable unattended download URL, so its tarball is obtained manually and wired through MHC_I_TAR/MHC_I_HOME. The protocol's own validator reports it as missing instead of failing silently.
Same situation as tests.TestMHCIPrediction for the IEDB MHC-II standalone tool, wired through MHC_II_TAR/MHC_II_HOME.
Exercises BepiPred-3.0 and the MHC-I/MHC-II tools together, so it needs all three manual downloads at once.
The IEDB class I immunogenicity tool is a manual, license-gated download wired through IMMUNO_TAR/IMMUNO_HOME, and the test also needs the MHC-I tool to produce its input epitopes.
The IEDB population coverage tool is a manual, license-gated download wired through COVERAGE_TAR/COVERAGE_HOME, and the test also needs the MHC-II tool to produce its input epitopes.
ElliPro ships as a jar that is not redistributable and is obtained manually, wired through ELLIPRO_JAR/ELLIPRO_HOME. The protocol's own validator reports it as missing instead of failing silently.
Covers every selectable MHC-I/MHC-II method plus the alternative BepiPred prediction mode, so it depends on the same manual downloads as the tests above.

The IEDB B-cell reference cannot be installed unattended: IEDB's bulk export terms of use do not clearly permit redistributing even a filtered subset, so the reference file is downloaded and filtered locally and wired through IEDB_BCELL_REFERENCE_PATH. The test already skips itself when that variable points nowhere.
